text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Christmas. At Tracen Academy, a Christmas party
hosted by the student council was set to take place.

text_block_list.name: Helios & Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Merry merry, Merry-ccho☆
Let's all get hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I-I-Is the party itself not a Christmas present in and of itself?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume representing the academy are all gathered here!
It's packed to the gills! Ahh, just the air alone feels like
it's gonna deliver a holy punishment~

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright, here's what you've all been waiting for!
It's time for the Gift Shuffle Corner!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We'll shuffle all the presents we brought
and do an exchange!
Hope you get something good!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I want that, I want this, I want that too. I want it all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
After agonizing over it to the point of ascending to heaven, I went with this.
Ehehe... No matter whose I pull, it'll be a family heirloom!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Man, this is absolute paradise. Getting presents from an Umamusume like this...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I get to be with a Trainer
who loves Umamusume so, so, so very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital was overcome with emotion.
And now, it was finally time to open the presents.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright everyone, on three,
let's all open our packages!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ready, and―― Open!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-What is this—?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital opens the package on the table as well.
What comes out of the box?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A calculator...
It's a desktop calculator!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
To think I'd receive something like this...
Oooohhh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, not particularly. But a present from an Umamusume-chan?
Now that's a whole different story!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's count our capsules before bed each night.
Though I wonder, who could have sent this?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —It's me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, Shakur-san!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Figures~ When it comes to calculations, Shakur-san's the one. Digitan gladly accepts~.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "To think it would go to a classmate. The chances of mine ending up with you were barely over 1%..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe this is some kind of coincidence, too. In that case,
I'll throw in another present for ya."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, extra novelty gifts, are you a god?!
Um, what are you giving us?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Heh, about that...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: This is a "challenge"! Take me on!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
S-Shakur-san!?
But Shakur-san, you said before
that you weren't interested in me...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That was before, yes. But after watching you run this past year,
I've changed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Your running style works on any track condition...
I'm curious how you make that tick.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, I never noticed.
Didn't think someone this interestin' was in our class.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hang out with me for a while.
Run alongside me and let me collect some data.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa, is this a dream?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The Heavenly Rock Cave that hadn't budged an inch until now
has finally opened!! And—!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whoa, hold on, Shakur-kun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Digital-kun is an important subject for my experiments.
I would appreciate it if you didn't borrow her without permission.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You bastard...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital's roommate,
Agnes Tachyon, stepped in.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, you're annoying.
Just hand it over already.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I refuse. She is mine, after all.
As her roommate, I hold priority usage rights.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't act so smug just 'cause you've known 'em longer!
I'm taking this one!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What kind of turn of events is this!??
This isn't some kind of mistake, is it!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Truly... taboo... To think someone like me
would be caught between these two..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, Digi-tan has... become a gust of wind...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital looked blissfully happy
having caught the interest of so many Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Autograph boards... I see...
There are so many Umamusume autographs...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait, WHAAAAT!? Doesn't this have
everyone's autographs on it!?
Wha, wha, WHAAAT!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-Why is such an incredible treasure here!?
Forget a family heirloom, this is a national treasure class masterpiece, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If this went to auction,
it'd easily fetch at least 1,000,000 Umapy.
Why on earth do I have something like this?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It seems you like it,
Agnes Digital.
That is a present from all of us.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: P-P-President-samaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital, with your ability to run on any track, you have captivated countless Umamusume fans.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, the appeal of Umamusume reached far and wide.
It's a considerable contribution to Tracen Academy as a whole.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I thought about giving you a formal commendation—
but you have rather eccentric tastes, don't you?
So...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"We thought you'd prefer this.
It's a small token of gratitude from us."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: O-O-O-OOOOOOOOOOOHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji & Opera O
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays! Agnes Digital!

text_block_list.name: Dotou & Urara
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays! Agnes Digital!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaaaaaat,
Trainer, Trai...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (I can see it... I can see it too... the other side of the Pure Land...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Screams of sheer bliss echoed through the holy night sky.
For Agnes Digital, it became the happiest Christmas ever.
